text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Copano Rickey set out to find 
Umamusume who could help her grow 
stronger, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "Help out with training"? I mean, I 
did say people who help are important, but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I can't help out. I've already 
set my schedule towards my goals, and I 
don't have time right now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho oho, a training partner? Of course, 
you're more than welcome~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Thank you, Acute-san☆ Well then, 
let's start the mock race right away...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hooooryaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Trainer, you're way too good, 
this isn't even a match...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Wonder Acute. While she has the cozy 
personality of an old granny, she is one 
of the strongest contenders on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has nearly 30 career starts. While she 
hasn't won a GⅠ, she has two 2nd-place 
finishes and three graded stakes wins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She had once engaged in a fierce, 
neck-and-neck battle against the famed 
dirt Umamusume Smart Falcon. She was far 
too out of my league as a training 
partner."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, even if she agreed to help, an 
Umamusume who's too strong wouldn't create 
'mutual generation'... we wouldn't be able 
to elevate each other."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just like me, they might need to be an 
Umamusume who has either just debuted or 
hasn't debuted yet.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't think of any power-type 
Umamusume who'd handle dirt no problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apart from Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute, 
no one else immediately comes to mind, for 
sure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, if I were to purposely look for 
a connection..."
choice_data_list: Do you have any feng shui tips?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A hint... Come to think of it, I think my 
lucky color was listed as "black"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Black." That seemed to be our only clue. 
For now, I decided to look for an 
Umamusume who might be related and bring 
her over.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Rickey-san!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan! Oh right, Kita-chan was here☆
choice_data_list: Are you two acquaintances, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Actually, when we were little, we 
used to play in the same park a lot!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan, is that true?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That was back before I met Dia-chan! 
We used to race each other and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Rickey-san would always find toys and 
things that we lost in the sandbox right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Kitasan Black. She's younger than Copano 
Rickey, and a kind-hearted Umamusume known 
as the 'Helping Hand Boss'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume with "Black" literally in her 
name. I brought her along as a test, 
and... it seems the threads of fate were 
connected from the past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this Umamusume is Satono Diamond. She 
is the heiress of the Satono Group, and 
also Kitasan Black's closest friend.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, to tell the truth, I'm looking 
for an Umamusume to train with me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind helping me out if you have 
a moment?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Leave any helping out to 
me♪ And besides...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for Ricky-san, who played with me 
so much and took such good care of me, I'd 
be more than happy to!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks☆ But it brings back memories, those 
days when we used to play together. That 
park...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There were so many kind gentlemen and 
ladies watching over us back then, weren't 
there?

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Alright, you two. I took down the 
hazardous fencing so you can play more 
easily, okay?

text_block_list.name: Old Caretaker
text_block_list.text:
Now there's no worry of bumping into 
anyone, so run with all your might.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're right! They took such great care of 
us. Thanks to them, we were able to run to 
our hearts' content every single day!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, one more time just like back 
then!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as fellow Umamusume who grew up in 
the same park, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, in that case, would you allow me to 
assist you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh, Dia-chan too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Depending on the type of training, I 
think it might be easier with three 
people.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I would be honored if I could be of help 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you! Please take good care of 
Dia-chan too, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My best friend Satono Diamond also 
enthusiastically offered to help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And day by day, the bond between the three 
of them deepened—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Rickey-san, thank you for your help today 
as well! I've been unable to wait since 
this morning!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What is today's feng shui oracle!?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, today... "Metal overcomes 
Wood." It looks like today isn't a very 
auspicious day for you with wood, 
Dia-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today's not good for 'wood' element...?! 
Then in that case!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's run on the woodchip course! Okay? I 
promise I'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Rickey-san, your feng shui is truly 
amazing. It's so spot-on, so...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Which makes overcoming the trial all the 
more rewarding! This is the absolute 
best!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Looks like they've taken quite a 
liking to you, Rickey-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, feels like Dia-chan was taken away 
from me a little~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond is an Umamusume unusually 
obsessed with breaking jinxes. She seemed 
to fit right in with that.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thanks to you, I think we've got 
some real momentum going☆ With the three 
of us♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's hone our running together!
Yeah, let's polish our running together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them formed a perfectly 
complementary bond. A triangle of rivals 
pushing one another higher.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having forged a new bond, Copano Rickey's 
future opened wide before her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the way home that day—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah... That girl...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the school gates, Copano Rickey 
suddenly stopped in her tracks. Looking 
where her gaze was fixed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume and her Trainer were saying 
their goodbyes.

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you for everything, up until now.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Seeing Off
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but what a shame. To think she'd want 
to step down of her own accord...

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped. Even if the injury has 
healed, being in this state... Well then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume bows and walks away. At her 
back...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Umâ!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to contain herself, Copano Rickey 
called out.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"There's something wrong with your 
running, isn't there? If it's because you 
can't really feel positive about it..."

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Being able to get by with just that... was 
about half a year ago, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh... Six months ago...

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
At first, it was just a psychological 
issue, but after that, she lost her 
appetite, started staying up late...

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer tried to give me advice too, 
but bothering them like that just made me 
feel even worse.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Is that what happened...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Um! In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's decided. The shop I'm going to work 
at.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So I'm going to take this chance to start 
over.

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I guess I just didn't have enough talent. 
At least I can accept that."

text_block_list.name: Departing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sorry for making you worry. Well then.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind a slightly wistful smile, 
that Umamusume walked away. It's a rather 
common sight here at Tracen Academy, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... I managed it, right? I'm sure 
of it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, like "red in the east." Maybe try 
waking up at sunrise every morning?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Taking small mindful steps like that can 
often help someone get back on their feet. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I can't reach out and help, all I can 
do is watch them go. Ever since coming to 
Tracen Academy, that's happened time and 
time again. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to do something. Even just one 
thing I can do. Even if I can't do it 
right now. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I want to get stronger and spread the 
word about Feng Shui! So I can help as 
many people as possible, as soon as 
possible!!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta give it our all, Trainer! 
Right alongside Kita-chan and Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just strength for the sake of victory— 
but a gentle strength capable of 
supporting someone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Copano Rickey sought that answer, her 
eyes burned with a passion hotter than the 
crimson sunset.
